cards.ex: I can whip up a quick pasta dish if you're hungry.
cards.exUz: Agar och bo'lsangiz, tezda makaronli taom tayyorlay olaman.
cards.uzDef: Tez va oson biror narsani tayyorlamoq, masalan ovqat.

cards.ex: This recipe is a piece of cake; even I can make it!
cards.exUz: Bu retsept juda oson; hatto men ham qila olaman!
cards.uzDef: Juda oson bo'lgan narsa yoki vazifa.

cards.ex: Add salt and pepper, and season to taste.
cards.exUz: Tuz va murch qo'shing va ta'bga qarab ziravorlang.
cards.uzDef: Ovqatga ta'bga qarab ziravorlar qo'shish.

cards.ex: Let the sauce simmer down for about 20 minutes.
cards.exUz: Sousni taxminan 20 daqiqa davomida past olovda qaynatib qo'ying.
cards.uzDef: Qaynayotgan suyuqlikni olovni pasaytirib, sekin qaynatish.

cards.ex: That cake looks absolutely mouth-watering!
cards.exUz: Bu tort juda ishtaha ochar ko'rinadi!
cards.uzDef: Juda mazali ko'rinadigan va ishtahani ochadigan.

cards.ex: She always bakes her bread from scratch.
cards.exUz: U doimo nonini noldan pishiradi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday tayyor mahsulotlarsiz, boshidan boshlab.

cards.ex: Can I get a doggy bag for the leftovers?
cards.exUz: Qoldiq ovqat uchun qop olsam bo'ladimi?
cards.uzDef: Restorandan qolgan ovqatni olib ketish uchun qop.

cards.ex: They're having a bake off at the school fair.
cards.exUz: Maktab yarmarkasida pishirish tanlovi bo'lib o'tadi.
cards.uzDef: Pishirish tanlovi yoki musobaqasi.

cards.ex: I bit into the apple and it was so juicy.
cards.exUz: Olmani tishladim va u juda serob edi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tishlab, undan lazzatlanmoq.

cards.ex: Mac and cheese is my ultimate comfort food.
cards.exUz: Makaron va pishloq - bu mening eng yaxshi taskin beruvchi ovqatim.
cards.uzDef: Odatda oddiy, lekin qanoatlantiruvchi va kayfiyatni ko'taruvchi ovqat.

cards.ex: She's a real foodie; she loves trying new restaurants.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy ovqatsevar; u yangi restoranlarni sinab ko'rishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Ovqatga juda qiziqadigan va yaxshi ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: Add just a pinch of salt to the dough.
cards.exUz: Xamirga bir chimdim tuz qo'shing.
cards.uzDef: Juda oz miqdordagi narsa, odatda tuz yoki ziravorlar.

cards.ex: She cooked up a storm for the party.
cards.exUz: U ziyofat uchun juda ko'p ovqat pishirdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p ovqat pishirmoq, odatda mehmonlar uchun.

cards.ex: We eat out at least once a week.
cards.exUz: Biz haftada kamida bir marta tashqarida ovqatlanamiz.
cards.uzDef: Uyda emas, balki restoranda ovqatlanmoq.

cards.ex: We're having a potluck next weekend; bring your favorite dish.
cards.exUz: Keyingi hafta oxirida hamma olib keladigan tadbir bo'ladi; sevimli taomingizni olib keling.
cards.uzDef: Har bir ishtirokchi ovqat olib keladigan tadbir.

cards.ex: The food's ready, so tuck in!
cards.exUz: Ovqat tayyor, shuning uchun ishtaha bilan yeng!
cards.uzDef: Ishtaha bilan ovqat yemoq.

cards.ex: I'm so full, but I think I'll have seconds.
cards.exUz: Men juda to'ydim, lekin menimcha, ikkinchi porsiya olaman.
cards.uzDef: Ovqatning ikkinchi porsiyasi.

cards.ex: I spend Sunday afternoons doing meal prep for the week.
cards.exUz: Men yakshanba kunlari tushdan keyin hafta uchun ovqat tayyorlash bilan shug'ullanaman.
cards.uzDef: Kelgusi kunlar uchun ovqat tayyorlash.

cards.ex: After that huge meal, I'm definitely in a food coma.
cards.exUz: Shu katta ovqatdan keyin, men aniq ovqatdan keyingi uyqu holatidaman.
cards.uzDef: To'yib ovqat yegandan keyin paydo bo'ladigan uyqu holati.

cards.ex: What's on the menu tonight?
cards.exUz: Bugun menuda nima bor?
cards.uzDef: Menuda mavjud bo'lgan taomlar.

cards.ex: Let's get takeout tonight; I don't feel like cooking.
cards.exUz: Keling, bugun olib ketishga buyurtma beramiz; pishirishni xohlamayman.
cards.uzDef: Restorandan olib ketiladigan ovqat.

cards.ex: Eat your heart out, Gordon Ramsay!
cards.exUz: Hasad qiling, Gordon Ramsay!
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir hasad qildirish uchun ajoyib ish qilmoq.

cards.ex: Let's spice things up and try a new recipe.
cards.exUz: Keling, ziravor qo'shamiz va yangi retseptni sinab ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qiziqarli o'zgarishlar kiritmoq.

cards.ex: Let's grab a bite before the movie starts.
cards.exUz: Keling, kino boshlanishidan oldin yengil tamaddi qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Tez va osonlik bilan ovqatlanmoq.

cards.ex: I'm having leftovers for lunch tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Ertaga tushlikka qoldiq ovqat yeyman.
cards.uzDef: Ovqatdan keyin qolgan ovqat.

cards.ex: I think I have food poisoning; I feel terrible.
cards.exUz: O'ylaymanki, men ovqatdan zaharlanganman; o'zimni yomon his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Buzilgan ovqatdan zaharlanish.

cards.ex: They deep-fry everything at that restaurant.
cards.exUz: Ular o'sha restoranda hamma narsani ko'p yog'da qovuradi.
cards.uzDef: Ovqatni ko'p miqdordagi issiq yog'da pishirmoq.

cards.ex: Can you set the table while I finish cooking?
cards.exUz: Men pishirishni tugatgunimcha siz stolni tuzay olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Ovqatlanish uchun stolni tayyorlamoq.

cards.ex: Make sure you clean your plate before you leave the table.
cards.exUz: Stoldan turishdan oldin taomingizni to'liq yeganingizga ishonch hosil qiling.
cards.uzDef: Taomdagi hamma narsani yemoq, hech narsa qoldirmasdan.

cards.ex: He was so hungry he wolfed down his dinner.
cards.exUz: U juda och edi, shuning uchun kechki ovqatini shosha-pisha yedi.
cards.uzDef: Juda tez va ochko'zlik bilan yemoq.
